notes.title: A Sneak Peak Into Littlelands
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=42-EjjuHkRc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]As premiered on #IGNLive:[/h1]

[b]We hope that you enjoy our sneak peek gameplay overview that we had prepared for #IGNLive.  It's beyond cool to have our title featured in 2 Summer Games Fest Showcases. [/b]

Dive deep into the adorable world of Littlelands, a charming and colorful diorama-style wonderland brimming with secrets. Journey on a once-in-a-lifetime expedition when the simple task of repairing a computer becomes a mysterious adventure across hills, valleys, and caves filled with adventure.

Every big adventure starts with a small step! Fashion the perfect tiny protagonist with dozens of appearance options. Chat with eccentric neighbors to activate rewarding jaunts leading travelers into the uncharted wilds. Traverse an eclectic array of locations, from lush green jungles to sunset-hued red deserts. Unfold the 3D world map to get a bird’s eye view of epic escapades on the horizon. 

Brave daunting dungeons overrun with unfriendly creatures like bats, goblinetes, and skeletons, in hopes of excavating long-lost treasure and relics. Break a sweat during combat, but push past the limit without rest and a fainting spell may send adventurers out of commission.  

Between compelling quests, embrace the cozy life amidst Littelands’ day-to-day activities, cultivating farmland with wild seeds. Amass an envy-inspiring collection of wildlife by casting the multi-purpose catching rod into lakes and bushes, capturing rare bugs and fish. Trade exotic flora and fauna at the Flower Shop, or unearth fascinating fossils to display at the Museum.

Wishlist Littlelands on Steam!  Our demo is coming soon, so stay tuned and [b][url=https://x.com/Littlelands]follow us on Twitter/X[/url][/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083660/Littlelands/

notes.title: Gettin' Cozy with Wholesome Games Direct
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hBY3qtel9JI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]We were featured in Wholesome Game Direct![/h1]
Initially, we had planned to share that we were going to launch the game's demo!  However, our team wanted to make sure that the demo was absolutely perfect. Please see a note from our developers below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978728/27d996916b6b6702b02fd9fd969f5506fa3cd66d.png[/img]

[ ALT Text: ]
Today, during the Wholesome Games Direct, we were truly thrilled to announce the launch of a free demo for Littlelands on Steam. After thoughtful discussions between our development team and Apogee, we have made the tough decision to postpone the release of the demo for now.

We understand this news might be disheartening, and for that, we sincerely apologize. Our primary goal is to ensure that Littlelands delivers the cozy, delightful experience you expect and deserve from the very beginning. It’s important for us to fine-tune every detail, so your journey through Littlelands is as charming and enjoyable as possible.

Please know that we are dedicated to making Littlelands the best it can be. We have more to share with you today at IGN Live, and we hope you’ll remain enthusiastic about the enchanting adventures we have in store for you with Littlelands.

With deepest gratitude for your ongoing support and understanding,

Warmest wishes,  
The Littlelands Team
